{{Top|leg}}
An '''Authority Merchant Marine Academy''' was an institution for the training of potential members of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Picket Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Prior to enlistment in the Authority's merchant navy, training was required at one of the [[Academy|academies]]. Crew members aboard merchant vessels held diverse [[Military rank/Legends|military-like ranks]] and were sometimes members of various interstellar trade unions. There was an Authority Merchant Marine academy located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]], in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].
